title: LM358 上面包板：先不接反馈，再接成跟随器
summary: 芯片横跨凹槽、接好电源脚。先不接反馈线，看输出一下子顶到头；接上反馈，它就乖乖跟着输入走。

rail.title: 认识 LM358：缺口和 8 只脚
text: LM358 在一颗 8 脚芯片里装了**两个 op-amp（运算放大器）**。我们用第一个，叫 **A**。
![](inside:lm358#1)
| 脚 | 名字 | 属于 | 它是什么 | 这一课接到 |
| 1 | OUT A | op-amp A | 输出 | 先什么都不接；第 6 步接回 2 脚 |
| 2 | IN− A | op-amp A | 反相输入 | 反馈线（先不接） |
| 3 | IN+ A | op-amp A | 同相输入 | 电位器滑动端 |
| 4 | V− | A、B 共用 | 负电源 | GND |
| 8 | V+ | A、B 共用 | 正电源 | +9 V |
| 5 / 6 / 7 | IN+ B / IN− B / OUT B | op-amp B | 第二个 op-amp | 本课不用 |

rail.title: 接电源，插芯片
text: 芯片的 8 脚（V+）在下半区，所以上下两组电源轨都要有电。

rail.title: 电位器给 IN+ 一个电压
text: 电位器两端接 GND 和 +9 V，滑动端就能给出 0 到 9 V 之间的任意电压。

rail.title: 一个放大十万倍的裁判
text: op-amp 比较两个输入，把它们的差 $v_d = V(IN+) − V(IN−)$ 乘上一个很大的增益 $A ≈ 100\,000$：

rail.title: 接上反馈：输出接回 IN−
text: **负反馈**：把输出接回 IN−。输出只升到 IN− 追上 IN+ 为止，然后停住。输出复制了输入，这就是**电压跟随器**。
![](fig:follower)

rail.title: 带走
text: - 有了负反馈，两条规则几乎就够用：**$V(IN−) ≈ V(IN+)$**（虚短）和**输入端不取电流**（虚断）。
- 单电源 LM358 的输出只能从约 0 V 摆到约 **V+ − 1.5 V**。真实芯片的输入也最好低于这条线。
- 坑：别像第一次那样让 op-amp 的输入悬空，真实芯片会乱来。没用到的 B 半也接成跟随器，IN+ 接到一个固定电压。
- 下一步：用跟随器救一个被负载拉低的分压器。

sat.title: 不接反馈时，输出为什么不跟旋钮走
steps: IN− 什么都没接；IN+ 是滑动端的电压，比如 1 V。差 $v_d$ 大约就是 1 V。
电源只有 9 V，输出到不了这么高，只能停在它能到的最高处：比 V+ 低约 1.5 V。
旋钮从 10% 拧到 90%，$v_d$ 一直是正的、而且远大于 0.1 mV，输出就一直贴在天花板上。这叫**饱和**。

description: LM358 是一颗 DIP-8 芯片，里面有两个 op-amp（运算放大器）。op-amp 把两个输入的差放大约 10 万倍；把输出接回反相输入（负反馈），它就成了电压跟随器：输出 = 输入。单电源时输出最高约 V+ − 1.5 V。

caption.text: LM358 横跨凹槽：上排 e 是 1–4 脚，下排 f 从右往左是 5–8 脚。每只脚独占一条金属条。

i18n.en: The LM358 straddles the trench: row e holds pins 1–4, row f pins 8–5 (left to right). Each pin has its own strip.

caption.text: 电压跟随器：输出接回 IN−。op-amp（运算放大器）让 IN− 追上 IN+，所以 V_out = V_in。

i18n.en: Voltage follower: the output feeds IN−. The op-amp makes IN− catch up with IN+, so V_out = V_in.

en.title: LM358 on the breadboard: no feedback first, then a follower
en.summary: Straddle the trench, power the chip. Leave the feedback wire out and watch the output slam to the top; wire it in and the output follows the input.
en.description: The LM358 is a DIP-8 chip with two op-amps inside. An op-amp multiplies the difference of its two inputs by about 100 000; wiring the output back to the inverting input (negative feedback) makes a voltage follower: output = input. On a single supply the output reaches only about V+ − 1.5 V.
steps: **9 V battery**: + in **`tp1`**, − in **`tn1`**. Pin 8 sits in the bottom half, so the bottom rails need power too: red jumper **`tp30`** → **`bp30`**, blue jumper **`tn29`** → **`bn29`**.

Pick **Op-amp LM358** and click **`e10`** (pin 1, notch on the left). The chip straddles the trench: pins 1–4 in `e10`–`e13`, pins 8–5 in `f10`–`f13`, each pin on its own strip.

![](fig:pins)
**Power pins**: red jumper **`j10`** → **`bp10`** (pin 8, V+, to +9 V), blue jumper **`a13`** → **`tn13`** (pin 4, V−, to GND).

**Potentiometer** `10 kΩ`, click **`c20`** (legs in `c20`, `c21`, `c22`). Its ends: blue jumper **`a20`** → **`tn20`**, red jumper **`a22`** → **`tp22`**. Wiper to IN+: jumper **`b21`** → **`b12`** (pin 3).
**No feedback wire yet.** Put the multimeter's red probe on **`d10`** (pin 1, the output). Click the pot and drag its wiper in **Properties** from `10%` to `90%`: what does the output do?
**Add the feedback**: jumper **`a10`** → **`a11`**, from pin 1 (output) back to pin 2 (IN−).
Drag the wiper again and watch **`d10`**; then move the red probe to **`d12`** (pin 3, IN+) and compare.
Turn the wiper to **`100%`** (IN+ = 9 V) and look at the output again: it stops well short of 9 V. **Diagnostics** reports the output as saturated.
hints: Follower: output to IN−, signal to IN+; the op-amp makes the two inputs equal.
With pin 1 on GND and pin 3 on 9 V, the wiper voltage = wiper position × 9 V.
The output never goes above V+ − 1.5 V.
tests: Wiper in the middle: the output follows the input
Wiper at the top: the supply limits the output

measurements.ask: With no feedback wire, drag the wiper from `10%` to `90%`. What does the output (`d10`) do?
choices: it sits at one level a little below 9 V and hardly follows the knob
it follows the knob from low to high
measurements.explain: IN− is open and the difference is multiplied by 100 000: the output hits the ceiling and stays there. The next step shows why.

measurements.ask: Wiper at `70%`: IN+ (column 12, pin 3) to GND
Same setting: the output (column 10, pin 1) to GND
Wiper at `100%`: the output to GND
measurements.explain: IN+ is at 9 V, but the output tops out at V+ − 1.5 V ≈ 7.5 V.

choices: the LM358's output can't reach V+; it tops out about 1.5 V below
measurements.ask: Why does the output stop following the input at 100%?
measurements.explain: A single-supply op-amp has a limited output swing. For signals close to the supply, pick a rail-to-rail op-amp or raise V+.

rail.title: Meet the LM358: the notch and 8 pins
text: The LM358 holds **two op-amps** in one 8-pin chip. We use the first one, called **A**.
![](inside:lm358#1)
| Pin | Name | Belongs to | What it is | In this lesson |
| 1 | OUT A | op-amp A | output | nothing yet; step 6 wires it back to pin 2 |
| 2 | IN− A | op-amp A | inverting input | the feedback wire (not yet) |
| 3 | IN+ A | op-amp A | non-inverting input | the pot's wiper |
| 4 | V− | shared by A and B | negative supply | GND |
| 8 | V+ | shared by A and B | positive supply | +9 V |
| 5 / 6 / 7 | IN+ B / IN− B / OUT B | op-amp B | the second op-amp | not used here |

rail.title: Power the rails, put in the chip
text: Pin 8 (V+) sits in the lower half, so both pairs of rails need power.

rail.title: A pot gives IN+ a voltage
text: With its ends on GND and +9 V, the pot's wiper gives any voltage from 0 to 9 V.

rail.title: No feedback yet: turn the knob, watch the output
text: ![](steps:here)
![](measure:open)
![](inside:lm358#5)

rail.title: A referee that multiplies by 100 000
text: An op-amp compares its two inputs and multiplies the difference $v_d = V(IN+) − V(IN−)$ by a huge gain $A ≈ 100\,000$:
![](derive:sat)

rail.title: Add the feedback: output back to IN−
text: **Negative feedback**: wire the output back to IN−. The output rises only until IN− has caught up with IN+, then holds. The output copies the input: a **voltage follower**.
![](fig:follower)

rail.title: Compare: the output and IN+
text: ![](steps:here)
Readings are taken on the whole circuit: press **Check my circuit** once and the reading boxes open.
![](measure:vin)
![](measure:vout)

rail.title: Turn it to 100%: the ceiling
text: ![](steps:here)
![](measure:vtop)
![](measure:why)
![](inside:lm358#9)

rail.title: Take away
text: - With negative feedback, two rules do almost all the work: **$V(IN−) ≈ V(IN+)$** (virtual short) and **no current into the inputs** (virtual open).
- A single-supply LM358 swings its output from about 0 V up to about **V+ − 1.5 V**. A real one also wants its inputs below that line.
- Pitfall: never leave an op-amp input floating, as in the first try: a real chip then does anything. Wire the unused half B as a follower with its IN+ tied to a fixed voltage.
- Next: use the follower to rescue a divider that a load has pulled down.

sat.title: Why the output ignores the knob without feedback
steps: IN− is connected to nothing; IN+ sits at the wiper's voltage, say 1 V. The difference $v_d$ is about 1 V.
The supply is 9 V. The output can't go that high, so it stops at the highest it can reach: about 1.5 V below V+.
From 10% to 90% on the knob, $v_d$ stays positive and far above 0.1 mV, so the output stays stuck at the ceiling. That is **saturation**.

tests.name: 滑动端在中间：输出跟着输入
滑动端到顶：输出被电源限制

measurements.ask: 不接反馈线时，把滑动端从 `10%` 拖到 `90%`，输出（`d10`）怎样？
choices: 一直停在一个比 9 V 低一截的地方，几乎不跟旋钮走
measurements.explain: IN− 悬空，差值被放大十万倍：输出撞到天花板，停在那里不动。下一步看为什么。

measurements.ask: 滑动端 `70%`：IN+（3 脚所在的第 12 列）对 GND 的电压
同一状态：输出（1 脚所在的第 10 列）对 GND 的电压
滑动端拧到 `100%`：输出对 GND 的电压
measurements.explain: IN+ 已经是 9 V，可输出最高只有 V+ − 1.5 V ≈ 7.5 V。

measurements.ask: 为什么滑动端在 100% 时，输出不再等于输入？
choices: LM358 的输出到不了 V+，最高约 V+ − 1.5 V
measurements.explain: 单电源 op-amp（运算放大器）的输出摆幅有限。要处理接近电源的信号，选“轨到轨”（rail-to-rail）op-amp，或者提高 V+。

steps.text:
选**「op-amp（运算放大器）LM358」**，单击 **`e10`**（1 脚，缺口在左）。芯片横跨凹槽：1–4 脚在 `e10`–`e13`，8–5 脚在 `f10`–`f13`，每只脚独占一条金属条。

![](fig:pins)
**先不接反馈线。** 万用表红表笔点 **`d10`**（1 脚，输出）。单击电位器，在「属性」里把滑动端从 `10%` 拖到 `90%`：输出怎么变？
再拖一次滑动端，看 **`d10`** 的读数；然后把红表笔移到 **`d12`**（3 脚，IN+）比一比。
把滑动端拧到 **`100%`**（IN+ = 9 V），再看输出：它停在比 9 V 低一截的地方。「诊断」会提示输出饱和。

hints: 跟随器：输出接 IN−，信号接 IN+，op-amp（运算放大器）让两个输入相等。
电位器 1 脚接 GND、3 脚接 9 V 时，滑动端的电压 = 滑动端位置 × 9 V。
输出不会超过 V+ − 1.5 V。
